svg.aria-label: Lumo, decentralised collision avoidance for drone swarms. In a 60-drone worst-case crossing, a speed governor derived from turning physics reduced collisions from 717 to zero, with every drone still reaching its goal.

g.text: 60 drones swap sides through one crossing point
